+"""In-process counters exported to the ops dashboard (REQ-OBS-402)."""
+from collections import Counter
+from threading import Lock
+
+_counts = Counter()
+_lock = Lock()
+
+
+def inc(name: str, by: int = 1) -> None:
+    with _lock:
+        _counts[name] += by
+
+
+def get(name: str) -> int:
+    return _counts[name]
+
+
+def reset() -> None:
+    with _lock:
+        _counts.clear()
+
+
+def snapshot() -> dict:
+    with _lock:
+        return dict(_counts)

--- a/ledger/ratelimit.py
+++ b/ledger/ratelimit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+"""Login throttling (REQ-SEC-302): 5 failures lock the account for 15 minutes."""
+import time
+
+MAX_FAILURES = 5
+LOCK_SECONDS = 15 * 60
+
+
+class LoginLimiter:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._failures = {}
+        self._locked_until = {}
+
+    def failed(self, user_id: str, now: float | None = None) -> None:
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        count = self._failures.get(user_id, 0) + 1
+        self._failures[user_id] = count
+        if count >= MAX_FAILURES:
+            self._locked_until[user_id] = now + LOCK_SECONDS
+            self._failures[user_id] = 0
+
+    def succeeded(self, user_id: str) -> None:
+        self._failures.pop(user_id, None)
+
+    def locked(self, user_id: str, now: float | None = None) -> bool:
+        now = time.time() if now is None else now
+        return now < self._locked_until.get(user_id, 0)
